new_entities.name: Tirzepatide for obesity-related HFpEF
new_entities.description: Use of tirzepatide in patients with heart failure with preserved ejection fraction and obesity.

new_entities.name: Clinical outcomes
new_entities.description: Clinical outcomes such as worsening heart failure, cardiovascular death, symptoms, quality of life, and functional capacity.

edges.effect_quant: In SUMMIT, tirzepatide lowered cardiovascular death or worsening heart-failure events versus placebo (HR 0.62) and improved KCCQ-CSS by 6.9 points at 52 weeks. CKD subgroup analysis showed the benefit was preserved across kidney-function strata, and early meta-analysis found a similar favorable composite signal (HR 0.50) in obesity-related HFpEF datasets.
edges.population: adults with heart failure with preserved ejection fraction and obesity, including substantial representation of patients with chronic kidney disease
edges.mechanism: Tirzepatide likely improves congestion, hemodynamics, inflammatory tone, and exercise tolerance through large weight reduction and broader cardiometabolic remodeling.
edges.summary: This is one of the most promising new obesity-phenotype HFpEF signals. The benefit is not only weight loss; the trial program suggests improvement in both symptoms and heart-failure events.
edges.caveats: The evidence base is still relatively young and centers on the SUMMIT program. Long-term mortality interpretation remains limited because event numbers are smaller than for classical heart-failure pharmacology trials.

evidence.citation: Packer M et al 2024 N Engl J Med
evidence.notes: Tirzepatide for Heart Failure with Preserved Ejection Fraction and Obesity. SUMMIT.

effect_quant.comparator: cardiovascular death or worsening heart-failure events in SUMMIT with tirzepatide versus placebo

evidence.citation: Packer M et al 2025 J Am Coll Cardiol
evidence.notes: Interplay of Chronic Kidney Disease and the Effects of Tirzepatide in Patients With Heart Failure, Preserved Ejection Fraction, and Obesity: The SUMMIT Trial.

effect_quant.comparator: SUMMIT subgroup analysis showed CKD did not attenuate tirzepatide's reduction in major adverse heart-failure events or its improvement in KCCQ-CSS
